title: Si: relax, SCF, bands and DOS (PBE)
description: Diamond silicon: a PBE cell relaxation (5.431 → 5.468 Å), a 16x16x16 mesh, a 302-point band path (Γ–X–U|K–Γ–L–W–X) and a tetrahedron DOS.
goal: Relax silicon, then calculate PBE bands and DOS.
source: VASP 5.4.4 on Slurm, 22 October 2026. PBE, 400 eV, 16x16x16 mesh.
note: Cluster labels and paths use placeholders. Inputs and numerical results are unchanged. This is not a convergence benchmark.
